nodes.name: 调用 API 获取所有工作流

parameters.command:
=export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
cd /home/node/n8n-backups

# 1. 配置 Git 基础信息
git config --global --add safe.directory /home/node/n8n-backups
git config --global user.name "n8n-bot"
git config --global user.email "n8n@local.com"

# 2. 绑定远程库
git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/lijixin0623/n8n-workflows-backup.git

# 3. 提交并推送
git add .
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  git commit -m "Auto backup workflows: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
  git push origin main
fi

nodes.name: 调用 API 获取所有工作流

parameters.command:
=export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
cd /home/node/n8n-backups

# 1. Base64 安全写入文件
echo "{{ Buffer.from($json.content).toString('base64') }}" | base64 -d > "{{ $json.fileName }}"

# 2. Git 基础配置
git config --global --add safe.directory /home/node/n8n-backups
git config --global user.name "n8n-bot"
git config --global user.email "n8n@local.com"

# 3. 读取环境变量中的 Token，不再硬编码
git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/lijixin0623/n8n-workflows-backup.git

# 4. 提交并推送
git add .
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  git commit -m "Auto backup: {{ $json.name }}"
  git push origin main
fi
